title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the specific campus spots where Bethel students actually spend their time, from the 'Egg' stairs to the quiet docks of Lake Valentine.

cards.title: The Egg Stairs
cards.subtitle: Brushaber Commons Atrium
cards.notes: Meet friends at the base of this central staircase for people-watching or to catch annual traditions like 'Christmas on the Egg.'
cards.short_summary: A central atrium staircase in the Brushaber Commons known by students as 'The Egg' for its distinctive shape and role as a social hub.
cards.evidence_claim: Students refer to the Brushaber Commons staircase as 'The Egg' and use it as a primary meeting spot and event location.
cards.access_notes: Open during Brushaber Commons building hours; accessible to all students.

cards.title: The Underground
cards.subtitle: Brushaber Commons Level 2
cards.notes: Head here for free 24/7 coffee, pool tables, and a dedicated lounge space designed specifically for commuters and PSEO students.
cards.short_summary: A renovated lower-level community space featuring games, 24/7 coffee, and resources for commuter students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Underground is a designated commuter lounge featuring free coffee 24/7 and various recreational equipment.
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 2 of BC; features 24/7 coffee access for students.

cards.title: Lake Valentine Dock
cards.subtitle: North End of Campus
cards.notes: Walk to the north end of campus to find this quiet dock, a favorite spot for sunset viewing and deep conversations away from the main buildings.
cards.short_summary: A peaceful wooden dock on the shores of Lake Valentine used by students for reflection and viewing sunsets.
cards.evidence_claim: The dock on Lake Valentine is a documented student spot for viewing sunsets and having 'deep talks.'
cards.source_title: Verdict: Lake Valentine is actually safe - The Clarion
cards.access_notes: Accessible via walking trails at the north end of campus.

cards.title: Kresge Courtyard Fire Pits
cards.subtitle: East of Brushaber Commons
cards.notes: Gather around the gas fire pits in this student-funded courtyard for late-night s'mores or outdoor study sessions.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor gathering space featuring commercial-grade gas fire pits and device charging stations.
cards.evidence_claim: Kresge Courtyard features two commercial-grade gas fire pits and was funded by the Bethel Student Government.
cards.source_title: Bethel Student Government (BSG) Funds Patio Expansion in Kresge Courtyard
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space accessible year-round; fire pits are typically available for student use in the evenings.

cards.title: The Shack
cards.subtitle: Nelson Hall Lounge
cards.notes: Visit the main lounge of Nelson Hall, known as 'The Shack,' for nightly RA-led activities and community hangouts.
cards.short_summary: The central community lounge in Nelson Hall where nightly programming and social events take place.
cards.evidence_claim: The common lounge area in Nelson Hall is called 'The Shack' and hosts nightly activities.
cards.access_notes: Primarily for Nelson Hall residents, but often hosts open events for the freshman community.

cards.title: Wellness Center Cardio Floor
cards.subtitle: WLC Level 2
cards.notes: Use the treadmills on the second floor for a workout with floor-to-ceiling views of the campus woods and Lake Valentine.
cards.short_summary: The upper level of the Wellness Center featuring extensive cardio equipment and scenic campus views.
cards.evidence_claim: The top floor of the Wellness Center is dedicated to general fitness and features 37 pieces of cardio equipment with large windows.
cards.source_title: Wellness Center - Facilities - Bethel University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Free access for students with Bethel ID; closed during chapel hours (10:10-11 a.m. MWF).

cards.title: The Loft
cards.subtitle: Near the President's Office
cards.notes: Find this quiet, sun-drenched study area located just outside the president's office for focused work between classes.
cards.short_summary: A bright and quiet study space available to all students during business hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Loft is a bright, quiet study space available to all students, located just outside the president's office.

cards.title: Hagstrom Level 2 Lounge
cards.subtitle: Hagstrom Center
cards.notes: A reliable spot for a quick snack and study break, featuring vending machines and seating in the heart of the academic complex.
cards.short_summary: A functional student lounge area in the Hagstrom Center known for its convenient vending access.
cards.evidence_claim: Vending machines and student seating are located on level 2 of the Hagstrom Center.
cards.source_title: St. Paul Campus Information - Bethel University
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; accessible via skyway.

cards.title: Monson Balcony
cards.subtitle: Brushaber Commons Level 4
cards.notes: Escape the main dining hall rush by heading to the balcony level for a quieter meal with views of the atrium.
cards.short_summary: The upper seating level of the main dining center, offering a more secluded atmosphere for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Monson Dining Center includes a quieter balcony level for student seating.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Monson Dining Center operating hours; requires meal plan or door rate for entry.

cards.title: Royal Grounds Patio
cards.subtitle: Brushaber Commons
cards.notes: Grab a boba tea or Caribou Coffee and head to the adjacent seating area with large windows overlooking the campus landscape.
cards.short_summary: The seating area for the campus coffee shop, known for its views and central location.
cards.evidence_claim: Royal Grounds is the campus coffee shop serving Caribou Coffee and boba tea, located in the Brushaber Commons with views of Lake Valentine.
cards.access_notes: Open daily during the academic year; hours vary during breaks.
